access.instructions: Tap App review access and use the dedicated credentials supplied only in the store review console. The account opens an isolated personal workspace with all core mobile features; no invitation, payment, OTP or third-party account is required.

apple.reviewNotes: OKRI is an authenticated team productivity companion. Sign in with Apple or Google to create an empty personal workspace. Core OKR, Project, Task, Routine and Daily features are available without payment. Account deletion is in More > Settings. No subscription purchase or external payment steering appears in the app.

googlePlay.targetAudience: Adults and workplace teams; not designed for children
googlePlay.appAccessInstructions: Tap App review access on the sign-in screen and enter the dedicated username and password supplied in Play Console. The account has access to all core mobile features in an isolated workspace. No Google account, invitation, OTP, payment or organization approval is required. Account deletion is available in More > Settings and at the public deletion URL.
